turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.
Happy to help you start a tattoo booking. Please tell me the design idea, the approximate size, where on the body you want it, and when you are available. A colleague will then take over the booking.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I have passed your request to a colleague: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available weekday evenings. A colleague will take over from here and get back to you about the booking.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a tattoo. Design: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date was given to the customer. Customer is not verified and no order was discussed.
